ai.title: US futures are flat as AI-related stocks hit by heavy selling, oil prices rise
ai.description: U.S. futures are nearly unchanged as artificial intelligence-related stocks were hit by heavy selling and oil prices climb. AI-related stocks have been veering up and down this summer on worries that their prices have shot too high and that the strong demand for memory, processors and other building blocks of data centers may fizzle if AI proves less profitable than promised. The futures for the S&P 500 were relatively unchanged Wednesday, while those for the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.1%. Nasdaq futures declined 0.1%.
ai.title_cn: 由于人工智能相关股票遭受大量抛售，油价上涨，美国期货持平
ai.description_cn: 由于人工智能相关股票受到大量抛售和油价攀升的打击，美国期货几乎没有变化。今年夏天，与人工智能相关的股票一直在上下波动，因为人们担心其价格过高，并且如果人工智能的利润低于承诺，对内存、处理器和其他数据中心构建模块的强劲需求可能会消失。周三标准普尔500指数期货相对没有变化，而道琼斯工业平均指数期货上涨0.1%。纳斯达克期货下跌0.1%。

ai.title: Rodic Consultants Partners with Nasscom to Launch National InfraAI Innovation Challenge for Smarter Infrastructure
ai.description: New Delhi [India], August 19: Rodic Consultants, one of India's leading infrastructure and engineering consultancies, has partnered with Nasscom to launch the Rodic InfraAI Innovation Challenge, a first-of-its-kind initiative aimed at accelerating the adoption of artificial intelligence across India's infrastructure and strategic sectors. Supported by Startup India through outreach to DPIIT-recognised startups, the initiative seeks to bring together the country's rapidly expanding AI and deep-tech ecosystem to develop scalable, deployment-ready solutions for some of India's most pressing infrastructure challenges.
ai.title_cn: Rodic Consultants与Nasscom合作，为更智能的基础设施发起全国AI创新挑战赛
ai.description_cn: 新德里[印度]，8月19日：印度领先的基础设施和工程咨询公司之一Rodic Consultants与Nasscom合作推出了Rodic CLARAI创新挑战赛，这是一项首创的举措，旨在加速印度基础设施和战略领域人工智能的采用。该计划在印度初创公司的支持下，通过与DPIIT认可的初创公司的推广，旨在将该国迅速扩张的人工智能和深度技术生态系统整合在一起，为印度一些最紧迫的基础设施挑战开发可扩展的、可部署的解决方案。
